glosses: impatience (the quality of being impatient; lacking patience; restlessness and intolerance of delays; anxiety and eagerness, especially to begin something)

examples.en: I'm looking forward to the party.

examples.text: Il attendait les nouvelles avec impatience.
J’attends avec impatience de vos nouvelles.
examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
He made a gesture of impatience.

examples.text: Nous attendons votre retour avec impatience.
examples.en: We look forward to your feedback.
